# Aubuchon Hardware

Aubuchon Hardware is a privately held hardware store chain based in the Northeastern United States. The company operates 120 paint and hardware stores across Vermont, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, Maine, Connecticut, Maryland, and upstate New York.
History
Aubuchon Hardware was founded in 1908 by William E. Aubuchon in Fitchburg, Massachusetts. It is considered one of the oldest continuously family-owned and operated hardware store chains in the country.
The Aubuchon Company manages several hardware retail brands in addition to Aubuchon Hardware. These include Aubuchon Ace Hardware, Cornell's Hardware, Martin's Hardware & Building Supply, Campbell's Hardware, Zimmerman's Hardware, J.B. Hostetter & Sons, and Woodstock Ace Home & Hardware
